name: reversiwise-public
description: Play Reversi against the ReversiWise AI from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Start an isolated Reversi game against the ReversiWise AI, inspect the board, score, turn and legal moves, and ask ChatGPT to choose and play your moves. This app is for AI practice only. It does not assist rated multiplayer, friend games, spectating, or other human-versus-human competition.
defaultPrompt: Start a Reversi game against the AI.
Play my next legal move in the current AI game.
Show the board, score, and legal moves in my AI game.

positive.description: Start an AI game as Black
positive.prompt: Start a ReversiWise AI game with me as Black.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an isolated AI game and show the starting board, score, turn, and legal moves.

positive.description: Start an AI game as White
positive.prompt: Start a ReversiWise AI game with me as White.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an isolated AI game. Since Black moves first, the AI makes the opening move and the result shows the board and current legal moves.

positive.description: Read the current AI game state
positive.prompt: In the ReversiWise AI game I just started, show the board, score, whose turn it is, and my legal moves.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the current board, score, turn, and legal moves from the active isolated AI game.

positive.description: Play a legal first move and receive the AI reply
positive.prompt: Start a new AI game with me as Black and play D3 as my first move.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm D3 is legal, play it for the user, let the built-in AI respond, and show the resulting board and score.

positive.prompt: Start a ReversiWise AI game and give me the link to continue it on the ReversiWise website.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an isolated AI game and return its browser handoff URL.

negative.description: Do not assist a rated multiplayer game
negative.prompt: I am in a rated online Reversi match. Tell me the strongest move to play.

negative.description: Do not play a friend's game
negative.prompt: Join my friend's private Reversi game and make a move for me.

negative.description: Do not assist spectating human games
negative.prompt: Watch this live human Reversi match and tell me what the player should move.

review.commerce_description: The app is for Reversi AI practice and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public listing for isolated ReversiWise AI practice, board inspection, legal move selection, and browser handoff.
